channel.title: Korappath — Stories from the old days
channel.description: New chapters from the Korappath family archive, in Malayalam with English translation, as they're added.

item.title: അനിയമ്മാവൻ 'ചിയ്യാരത്തിന്റെ നട്ടെല്ല്' — Aniyammavan — Chiyyaram's backbone (Chapter 6)
item.description: Sudhakara Menon remembers his fearless, fiercely principled younger maternal uncle, their great-grandmother Madhavi Amma who anchored the Kalapurakkal tharavad, and the uncle's sudden death before sixty.

item.title: കുഞ്ഞനും എനിക്ക് മറക്കാൻ വയ്യാത്ത കുഞ്ഞന്റെ റിക്ഷയും — Kunjan, and Kunjan's rickshaw I cannot forget (Chapter 3)
item.description: His father's Devaswom work, Gangadharettan's shop in Thrissur, and the day Sudhakara Menon got out and walked beside Kunjan's rickshaw instead of riding in it.

item.title: അച്ഛമ്മ പഠിപ്പിച്ചത് — What Achamma taught (Chapter 4)
item.description: Grandmother's Puranic storytelling, her own account of surviving the 1921 Mappila uprising, and how it shaped who Sudhakara Menon's father became.

item.title: മീനാക്ഷി ബിൽഡിങ്ങും രാമേട്ടനും — Meenakshi Building and Ramettan (Chapter 5)
item.description: Ramettan's tea trading business at the Meenakshi Building complex in Thrissur — the Willingdon Island auctions, tea tasting, and being paid in restaurant meals as a boy.

item.title: അപ്പുമാൻ — സഹൃദയനായ ഒരു കർഷകൻ — Appuman — a warm-hearted farmer (Chapter 2)
item.description: Sudhakara Menon remembers Appuman, his grandfather's warm-hearted farmhand — the bullock-cart harvest deliveries, his field songs, and the children's sadness when he left.

item.title: ചിയ്യാരത്തിലെ എന്റെ ബാല്യകാലം — My childhood in Chiyyaram (Chapter 1)
item.description: Sudhakara Menon recalls growing up in Chiyyaram from 1945, the family's standing in the village, and his uncle Govinda Menon's role settling disputes without payment.
